label: FGFR2::BICC1

sections.text: FGFR2 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
BICC1 encodes an RNA-binding protein that regulates messenger RNA translation and stability.

The fusion preserves the FGFR2 kinase region while altering its carboxy-terminal regulatory architecture; partner-mediated self-association can sustain FGFR signaling. FGFR2::BICC1 was detected in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
Futibatinib is US-approved for adults with previously treated, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring an FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement.
